name: solana-mcp-vybe
description:
Solana MCP by Vybe is a developer toolkit for live Solana data: wallets, trades, markets, and transfers. Ask for balances, PnL, holdings, prices, holders, and candles; scan markets, trades, and transfers; or pull top traders and labeled accounts.

Each tool calls one Vybe API endpoint and returns data. Swap quotes are quotes only. The plugin does not build, sign, or broadcast a transaction.
